newsitem.title: USA: AMRESCO to acquire lending firm in Idaho.
newsitem.headline: AMRESCO to acquire lending firm in Idaho.

text.p: AMRESCO Inc said Friday that it has definitively agreed to acquire Commercial Lending Corp, a commercial finance company in Boise, Idaho, for stock.
AMRESCO said it will make payments to Commercial Lending Corp shareholders in shares of AMRESCO common stock worth about $42 million.

"The acquisition of Commercial Lending Corp gives AMRESCO an excellent company through which it can enter the franchised commercial lending niche market," AMRESCO Chairman Robert Lutz said in a release.
Dallas-based AMRESCO handles sub-prime residential mortgages, commercial mortgage origination, underwriting and securitization and other real estate financial services.
